retained_input_origins.record: apps/desktop/scripts/bgm-source-bundle/README.md#collect-and-verify; the eight archives fetched by the BGM native compliance audit, plus the python-soundfile recipe archives and the pretty_midi sdist fetched for this bundle

components.name: libsndfile-1.2.0.tar.xz
components.evidence: the shipped DLL carries the banner 'libsndfile-1.2.0'; the same wheel's _soundfile_data/COPYING is the verbatim LGPL-2.1 text

components.name: flac-1.3.4.tar.xz
components.evidence: the shipped DLL carries the banner 'reference libFLAC 1.3.4 20220220'

components.name: libogg-1.3.5.tar.xz
components.evidence: the shipped DLL carries no libogg version string, so the audit records this version as unverified and collected 1.3.5 as the corresponding source

components.name: libvorbis-1.3.7.tar.xz
components.evidence: the shipped DLL carries the banner 'Xiph.Org libVorbis 1.3.7'

components.name: opus-1.3.1.tar.gz
components.evidence: the shipped DLL carries the banner 'libopus 1.3.1'

components.name: lame-3.100.tar.gz
components.evidence: the shipped DLL carries the banner 'LAME3.100 '

components.name: mpg123-1.29.3.tar.bz2
components.evidence: the shipped DLL exposes no version banner but embeds its own build path 'C:\vcpkg\buildtrees\mpg123\src\0d8db63f9b-3db975bc05.clean\src\libmpg123\id3.c'; vcpkg names an extracted build tree buildtrees/<port>/src/<SHA-512 of the source archive, first 10> -<port hash>.clean, and vcpkg's ports/mpg123/portfile.cmake at baseline 2023.01.09 pins MPG123_VERSION 1.29.3 with SHA512 0d8db63f9bae1507887bc5241a56abccfeb767b7ba8362eb0fce9de2f63369e57fdd6f25a953f8ef5f9ead4f400237db51914816e278566fdf8e6f205ebca5d6, which is the SHA-512 of this archive. The lock's build_tree_path is checked against the archive at build time.

components.name: soxr-1.1.0.tar.gz
components.evidence: this sdist ships libsoxr sources; libsoxr/src/soxr.h defines SOXR_THIS_VERSION_STR "0.1.3" and libsoxr/NEWS opens with 'Version 0.1.3 (2018-02-24)'; the wheel's licenses state LGPL-2.1-or-later

components.name: soundfile-0.12.1.tar.gz
components.linkage: cffi wrapper around the shipped libsndfile DLL
components.evidence: the locked soundfile wheel is built from this sdist; setup.py packages only a pre-existing _soundfile_data/libsndfile_64bit.dll and carries no library sources, which is why the recipe archives below are also required

components.name: python-soundfile-0.12.1.tar.gz
components.linkage: packaging recipe: build_wheels.py and setup.py assemble the released wheels around the DLL below
components.evidence: repository archive of the release; its .gitmodules resolves _soundfile_data to bastibe/libsndfile-binaries, the archive that supplies the DLL

components.name: libsndfile-binaries-d9887ef926bb11cf1a2526be4ab6f9dc690234c0.tar.gz
components.component: libsndfile_64bit.dll build recipe and vcpkg inputs
components.license: the recipe is part of the python-soundfile project; the DLL it ships is LGPL-2.1
components.evidence: .github/workflows/build-libs.yml builds with 'vcpkg install libsndfile:x64-windows-custom --overlay-triplets=triplets', triplets/x64-windows-custom.cmake holds that triplet, and the archive carries the produced DLL; the codec source archives above are the vcpkg port inputs for that build, whose upstream URLs and hashes vcpkg pins per port

components.name: pretty_midi-0.2.10.tar.gz
components.component: TimGM6mb SoundFont as distributed in pretty_midi 0.2.10
components.license: GPL-2 for the soundfont data; pretty_midi's MIT label covers its code only
components.evidence: the sdist and the wheel built from it both contain TimGM6mb.sf2; the Debian copyright record for timgm6mb-soundfont licenses that file under GPL-2
components.license_reason: this sdist contains no COPYING, LICENSE or copyright file, and no license text for the soundfont; the GPL-2 record that covers TimGM6mb.sf2 is the Debian copyright file carried by the BGM payload's own notices, not by this archive
